tagline: Three forms, and your form decides which cards are legal

featuredCards.title: Travel Form
featuredCards.caption: The pivot: cross four spaces and come out in whichever of the three forms the turn calls for.

featuredCards.title: Dire Bear Form
featuredCards.caption: A 5 to defend with that also drops you into Bear. The form change is the card.

featuredCards.title: Starfire
featuredCards.caption: Night Elf or Moonkin only — a 6 in Moonkin. In the wrong shape it is not even legal to play.

featuredCards.title: Hurricane
featuredCards.caption: The cash-out: every action you did not spend this turn becomes damage in Malfurion's zone.
